The '4/4 reproducible failure' that originally looked like strong evidence of a real model defect was actually the model being correct four times against a wrong expectation. This was compounded by never running the actual deterministic grading tool against either the original cases or the 'fix' -- both the original FAIL_ROUTING verdicts and the 2026-08-27 'PASS' verdicts were produced by manually reading raw JSONL primary_skill fields, not by the deterministic grader.
